name: Discord Tickets
description: Self-hosted ticket management bot with a web dashboard.
warnings: This replaces the files in your Cell. Previous files are retained in its installation backup.
Uses SQLite for a single-Cell setup. The project recommends an external database for production.
The 4.0 image is an upstream maintained tag; reinstalling can fetch a newer 4.0 release.
Set your Discord credentials, owner ID and dashboard URL on Startup before starting.

variables_schema.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
variables_schema.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables_schema.name: DISCORD_SECRET
variables_schema.description: OAuth2 client secret from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables_schema.name: HTTP_EXTERNAL
variables_schema.description: Public dashboard URL, including https://. Configure your reverse proxy and Discord OAuth2 redirect URI to match.

variables_schema.name: SUPER
variables_schema.description: Your Discord user ID. Comma-separated IDs are supported.

variables_schema.name: HTTP_TRUST_PROXY
variables_schema.description: Enable only behind a trusted reverse proxy.

files.PREINSTALL.md:
# Discord Tickets

Application code and dependencies are provided by the official container image. Your Cell stores configuration and persistent data in user/.

Configure private credentials, owner ID and dashboard URL on the Startup page before starting. SQLite is intended for a simple setup; consider an external database for production.

Documentation: https://discordtickets.app/self-hosting/
